audit.whatIsWrong: The page is graded TRICKY at 7/10 difficulty on a 55.04% win rate across 714 games — the best win rate of any matchup in this slice.
audit.why: A 55% lane is not a tricky one. The chart itself hands Ekko levels 6 onward.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, tone to the even colour, diffRating 5.5/10, and breakdown.difficulty plus report[14] restated to match. carryRating left at 7.5/10 — a point-and-click stun into full rotation is a real carry threat regardless of the lane result.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side read Annie/Annie/Skill/Skill/Annie/Skill/Skill while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Annie/Annie/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko. Every row disagreed, and rows 0, 1 and 4 disagreed in the opposite direction. content mid also closes with 'This remains her strongest phase of the matchup' about the level 6 row that win[4] awards to Ekko.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are even on range (1075 to 625) against a stun she starts the game holding; 3-5 are hers once the rotation can convert it; 6 is Chronobreak at 110s against a 130s bear.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content layer, whys rewritten to argue each verdict, and content mid corrected to stop contradicting its own row.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic three-clause template; whys[4] and whys[5] both described a first-item spike, so no row described level 6 at all.
audit.why: The level 6 row is Chronobreak (110s) against Summon: Tibbers (130s at rank 1) — the largest cooldown asymmetry in the lane.
audit.corrected: Spikes and whys[4]/[5] separated: 3-5 hers on the stocked stun, 6 the rewind, first item the string.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things were never stated. (a) Molten Shield does not just shield: it 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells', so Ekko's E-auto-passive string feeds it — it has to be forced out before the burst, and it is only 10s. (b) Pyromania is a CAST COUNTER, not a cooldown: four spells and her next offensive spell stuns, and she 'begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available' — the level 1 stun is live.
audit.why: Both are verbatim from Riot's text; the first is the missingInteractions entry for this matchup, and the second changes how a reader tracks the threat (count casts, not timers).
audit.corrected: Written into tradeGood, tradeBad, enemyWin, winCon, report[5], dontsFull[1], phases[0]/[1].why, whys[0]/[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers, and this lane has a decisive one: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Pyromania as a four-cast counter, Tibbers 130s, Molten Shield 10s, Chronobreak 110s.

notes:
RATING: this is a 55.04% matchup over 714 games and it was graded TRICKY at 7/10. Moved to EVEN / 5.5/10 with the tone colour and both rating lines restated. Annie's carryRating left at 7.5/10 — the point-and-click stun into full rotation is a genuine threat even in a lane Ekko wins.

CHART: full-layer sides read Annie/Annie/Skill/Skill/Annie/Skill/Skill against content win[] and packet.levelChart, which both read Skill/Skill/Annie/Annie/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko — all seven rows disagreed and three disagreed in the opposite direction. Full layer moved onto the content layer; no win[N] edits were possible (before would equal after). content mid was also arguing that level 6 'remains her strongest phase' directly under a row awarding level 6 to Ekko — corrected.

ADDED: Molten Shield 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells' — the E-auto-passive string feeds it, so it has to be forced out first (the missingInteractions entry). And Pyromania is a four-CAST counter that she 'begins the game and respawns with' available — the page treated it as a cooldown to wait out. Both are verbatim Riot text.

NOT CHANGED, flagged for a decision: focus.text still reads 'Annie Summon: Tibbers'. The spell this lane actually runs on is Pyromania, but focus.text is echoed by several fields that name Tibbers, so changing it alone would leave the page half-retargeted. See questionsForUser.
